preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 2e5 for line in stdin.splitlines() for x in line.split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: Input consists of integers n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2e5) and m (1 ≤ m ≤ 2e5) followed by m lines of two integers each, representing road connections between junctions (1 ≤ junction ≤ n).
Input has exactly m + 1 lines: first line is n and m, followed by m road connections.
Each of the m road connection lines contains exactly two integers.

preconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[0]) != int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: No road connects a junction to itself.

preconditions.expression: all((a, b) != (c, d) and (a, b) != (d, c) for i, (a, b) in enumerate([tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]) for j, (c, d) in enumerate([tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], i + 1))
preconditions.description: No two roads connect the same pair of junctions (undirected).

postconditions.description: Output is either 'NO' (impossible) or 'YES' followed by exactly three route descriptions (one per line).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and all(len(line.split()) >= 2 for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each route description line starts with an integer l ≥ 2 (number of junctions) followed by l junction numbers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and all(all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in line.split()[1:]) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: All junction numbers in routes are valid (1 ≤ junction ≤ n).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and all(len(set(line.split()[1:])) == len(line.split()[1:]) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: No route revisits the same junction (no duplicates in a single route).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and all(all(abs(int(line.split()[i]) - int(line.split()[i+1])) in {(a, b)[0], (a, b)[1], (b, a)[0], (b, a)[1]} for i in range(len(line.split()) - 2)) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Every consecutive pair of junctions in a route is connected by a road (using input roads).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and all(line.split()[1] == line.split()[-1] for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: All routes start and end at the same junction (start ≠ end).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and all(line.split()[1] != line.split()[2] for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: No route starts and ends at the same junction (start ≠ end).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and all(set(line.split()[1:]).issubset(set.union(*[set(line.split()[1:]) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:]])) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: All routes share exactly the same start and end junction (no other common junctions).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and all(len(set.union(*[set(line.split()[1:]) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:]])) == len(set.union(*[set(line.split()[1:]) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:]])) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: No two routes share any junction other than the common start and end.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and all(all((a, b) not in [(int(line1.split()[i]), int(line1.split()[i+1])), (int(line1.split()[i+1]), int(line1.split()[i]))] for line1 in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:] for i in range(len(line1.split()) - 2)) for line2 in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:] for j in range(len(line2.split()) - 2))
postconditions.description: No two routes share any road (undirected).
